title: New Hampshire Political Districts (Voting Wards) - 2022
description: The shapefile contains the basic building blocks for voting districts in New Hampshire. For cities, where there are voting wards, the ward boundaries are shown and polygons are identified by ward. For towns and cities where there are no wards, the entire municipality is shown and named.
snippet: New Hampshire political districts - voting district boundaries
accessInformation: Municipal boundaries from New Hampshire GRANIT base map data. Ward boundaries digitized by NH Office of Planning and Development, 2022.
